title: Two-sided chat thread with typing pills
summary: A vertical chat builds top-down on white: each message starts as a pill with pulsing dots, the pill stretches to the bubble size, then its words rise in. Five messages alternate grey left and blue right, one every ~2.8 s.
use_when: Telling a product story as a short dialogue between two people or a user and an agent
Vertical social posts where the conversation itself is the content
Opening a messaging, support or assistant product film before the real UI
Silent autoplay: every line is read on screen, no VO needed

look.type_style: humanist sans, semibold, sentence case, normal tracking, about 2.4 % H; dark grey on grey bubbles, white on blue bubbles

sfx.event: bubble finishes stretching and its text settles

structure.shot: empty white frame; grey typing pill top left, then the first incoming bubble: a greeting question, 3 words
structure.motion: pill pops in at 0.27 (springs.pop, overshoot not measurable, 8 fr ±0.25 s); dots pulse 1.0 s; dots fade at 1.50; pill stretches right to bubble width springs.layout 7 fr (±0.25 s); words rise in from a baseline mask 1.77-2.00, about 13 words/s

structure.shot: first bubble stays; blue typing pill on the right below it, then the outgoing reply: 5 words, one line
structure.motion: empty blue pill at 2.50, dots in by 2.77 (springs.pop, overshoot not measurable); dots pulse 1.0 s; 4.00 pill stretches leftward from the right edge (springs.layout, ±0.25 s); words rise in 4.27-4.77, about 8 words/s; settled 4.77

structure.shot: grey typing pill left under the reply, then the longest incoming message: about 10 words on 3 lines, an excited remark
structure.motion: pill pops in at 5.27 (springs.pop, overshoot not measurable); dots pulse 1.0 s; dots gone at 6.50; 6.77 pill grows in width and height to the 3-line bubble in one move (springs.layout, ±0.25 s); words rise in line by line 6.77-7.77, about 10 words/s

structure.shot: blue typing pill right, then the outgoing answer: about 7 words on 2 lines, agreeing and looking forward
structure.motion: empty blue pill at 8.27, dots in at 8.50 (springs.pop, overshoot not measurable); dots pulse 1.0 s; 9.77 pill stretches to a 2-line bubble (springs.layout, ±0.25 s); words rise in 10.00-10.77, about 9 words/s

structure.shot: grey typing pill left, then a one-word sign-off with an emoji; full five-bubble thread holds
structure.motion: pill pops in at 11.27 (springs.pop, overshoot not measurable); dots pulse 1.0 s; 12.77 pill stretches (springs.layout, ±0.25 s); word rises in at 13.00, emoji pops in at 13.27 (springs.pop, ±0.25 s); hold 0.73 s to the end

params.brand: any brand.json: bg (thread background), accent (outgoing bubble), muted surface (incoming bubble), fg, body font
params.content.messages: 3-6 messages {side: 'in'|'out', text}, alternating; 1-12 words each, the last one a short sign-off
params.aspect: 9:16 default; 4:5 and 1:1 keep the top-anchored thread with larger margins
params.timing.typing: frames the dots pulse before each bubble (default 30)
params.timing.gap: frames between a bubble settling and the next typing pill (default 15)
params.timing.wps: words per second for the word rise (default 10)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Single shot, no cuts; rows split at each new typing pill. The thread is top-anchored and never scrolls: bubbles stack downward with a constant gap of about 3.5 % H. Message period about 2.75-3.0 s: pill, 1.0 s of dots, stretch, then the words. Outgoing pills appear empty for one cell before the dots. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed terms (not in the vocabulary): typing-pill-stretch, chat-sequence.
